caption: This drawing depicts a single object, an elongated metal stand with an irregular, abstract form. The object is primarily rendered in shades of brown, suggesting a material like wrought iron with a weathered texture. The top portion of the stand features a flat, polygonal shape with uneven edges, transitioning into a squiggly, undulating vertical stem with a twisted central section. About a third of the way down, a looped protrusion extends to one side, resembling a handle or an attachment point. The stand is supported at the base by three curved legs that extend outward in a tripod arrangement, each ending in a slightly rounded tip. The overall composition places the object centrally on a plain, off-white background, with no additional items or features in the surrounding space. In the lower right corner, there is a small inscription or signature reading "LISLE J MACKLEM 52451 DEL."
title: Combination Rush/Candle Holder
